hypothesis: A preregistered ResComp 16x16 trellis correction and one representative Qwen block suffix can improve reconstruction without violating the frozen no-post-quant-GPTQ and YAQA-exclusion rules.
falsifier: The arithmetic oracle, deterministic manifest, trellis comparison, whole-block suffix, or resource bound fails.

decision_rules.accept: Oracle, deterministic payload, tile, suffix, and resource gates all pass.
decision_rules.reject: Any correction worsens the preregistered comparison or violates method policy.
decision_rules.futility: Stop promotion when tile evidence does not beat the control.
decision_rules.abort: Abort on OOM, nonfinite arithmetic, source drift, or YAQA/GPTQ overlap.
